text: 10月21日，上海证券交易所召开首批主动ETF市场动员会，9家首批主动ETF基金管理人、7家证券公司的40余名负责人员参会，会议旨在推动市场各方形成合力，保障首批主动ETF平稳落地运行，引导中长期资金入市。上交所相关负责人表示，将坚持”平稳起步、循序渐进、严防风险”，强化对主动ETF发行上市、投资运作、信息披露的全链条监管，确保首批主动ETF开好头、起好步。同时，持续丰富公募基金产品体系和高质量供给，和市场各方同题共答、增强合力，提升中长期资金A股投资比例与稳定性，更好服务实体经济和金融强国建设。
text_en: On October 21, the Shanghai Stock Exchange held a market mobilization meeting for the first batch of active ETFs. More than 40 responsible persons from 9 fund managers of the first batch of active ETFs and 7 securities companies attended. The meeting aimed to promote synergy among market participants, ensure the smooth launch and operation of the first batch of active ETFs, and guide medium- and long-term funds into the market. A relevant person in charge of the SSE said that the exchange will adhere to "a steady start, gradual progress, and strict risk prevention," strengthen full-chain supervision over the issuance and listing, investment operations, and information disclosure of active ETFs, and ensure that the first batch of active ETFs gets off to a good start. At the same time, the SSE will continue to enrich the public fund product system and high-quality supply, answer the same questions together with market participants and enhance synergy, increase the proportion and stability of medium- and long-term funds' A-share investment, and better serve the real economy and the building of a financial powerhouse.
